subject: AWS/GCP marketplace: security evidence package for co-sell listing
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@aws-partner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: security evidence for co-sell

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for working with AWS on the co-sell posture for GreenGrid Energy. Before we can progress the listing and enable co-sell enablement, accounting is asking for the canonical security/compliance artifacts they require for marketplace programs. Can you provide: 1) the most recent SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 letter) with applicable dates, 2) the high-level penetration test cover letter or executive summary (redacted is fine), and 3) a copy of the DPA you will sign with customers (or a template).

GreenGrid procurement asked that we get those items attached to the marketplace listing record and copied to procurement@greengrid.com. If you have a DocuSign-ready DPA link that speeds the process, that would be ideal. Also let me know if there are any standard carve-outs for marketplace customers.

Appreciate a quick ETA — AWS prefers to have these in the listing record within 48 hours to keep the co-sell timeline.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
Hannah.Lee@aws-partner.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@aws-partner.com>, procurement@greengrid.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: security evidence for co-sell

Hi Hannah / GreenGrid team,

Thanks — we can provide everything you requested. Attached are the current artifacts we use for marketplace and procurement reviews:

- SOC2_Report_Redwood_Inference_2024.pdf (full report, with bridge letter)
- PenTest_Summary_Redwood_Redacted.pdf (executive summary suitable for third parties)
- Redwood_DPA_GreenGrid_draft.docx (our standard DPA template; we typically sign a scoped appendix for marketplace customers)

A few notes:
- The SOC 2 is for the period ending 2024-12-31; bridge letter included in the PDF cover.
- The pen test summary omits exploit details; if GreenGrid needs the full technical report we can arrange an NDA and share with security contact.
- The DPA is our standard template. For marketplace deployments we usually accept the buyer-provided amendment for region-specific data controls; legal can confirm any redlines.

Stephanie / Monica — can you review the attached DPA and confirm whether we can accept the marketplace amendment and push a DocuSign? If possible, Id like to get a signed DPA in place by Monday so AWS can finalize the listing.

Hannah — I pasted relevant HubSpot and marketplace links in case you want to attach them directly to the record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345678 and the console link in related_links.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redwood_Inference_2024.pdf (pdf), PenTest_Summary_Redwood_Redacted.pdf (pdf), Redwood_DPA_GreenGrid_draft.docx (docx)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace listing: security evidence for co-sell

FYI — forwarding Hannah's request and the artifacts I attached.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@aws-partner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: security evidence for co-sell

> Thanks for working with AWS on the co-sell posture for GreenGrid Energy. Before we can progress the listing and enable co-sell enablement, accounting is asking for the canonical security/compliance artifacts they require for marketplace programs...

Stephanie — can you please: 1) review the DPA and flag any clauses we cannot accept for marketplace customers, 2) confirm if the redacted pen test summary is sufficient or if we need an on-letter signature from the pen-test vendor, and 3) approve the DocuSign flow for the DPA so I can share a link with Hannah and GreenGrid procurement.

If there's a quick redline, reply-all with the minimal version so I can keep the listing moving. We should try to meet their 48-hour window if possible.

Thanks,
Sergio
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@aws-partner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.com, AWS Marketplace Support <mp-support@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: security evidence for co-sell

Sergio — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping legal. We received the attachments and will add them to the marketplace record. Two quick asks to close the loop:

1) For AWS audit purposes, Marketplace Support prefers a short pen-test cover letter on vendor letterhead signed by the pen-test provider acknowledging the scope (public-facing endpoints + API). The redacted summary is fine for procurement, but Marketplace Support needs the vendor letter for listing validation.

2) Please provide a DocuSign-ready DPA link (or let us know if you prefer we prepare the DocuSign envelope). If you can share the DocuSign URL I will attach to the listing and prompt GreenGrid procurement to sign.

CC'd Marketplace Support so they see the artifacts; procurement@greengrid.com will confirm on their side once they see the DocuSign link.

Appreciate it — once we have the pen-test vendor letter and the DPA link we'll be able to finalize the listing and turn on co-sell.

Best,
Hannah
